# Reservours (through Mozrest)

Reservours connects through [Mozrest](mozrest.md). There are no Reservours-specific settings.

## What it does for the agent

Checks availability, books and cancels in Reservours.

## Before you start

- Everything in [Mozrest, "Before you start"](mozrest.md#before-you-start).
- The restaurant's Reservours account is connected to Mozrest, with its areas.

## Partner does in Reservours

Check in Mozrest that the restaurant's reservation system is Reservours. Nothing else in
Reservours itself.

## Assistant does in Newo

As on the [Mozrest page](mozrest.md#assistant-does-in-newo).

## Test

As on the [Mozrest page](mozrest.md#test).

## Needs Newo

As on the [Mozrest page](mozrest.md#needs-newo).

## Limits and known issues

No reschedule: cancel and book again. Other limits as for Mozrest.
